title: 2026 waste-battery emissions-control QA controls

sources.title: Waste batteries: appropriate measures - emissions control
Waste batteries: appropriate measures for permitted facilities

facts.source_fact: The guidance applies to regulated facilities with an environmental permit for treatment or transfer of separate waste batteries.
facts.expected_handling: Bind controls to the permitted waste-battery facility scope.

facts.source_fact: Operators must identify, characterise and control emissions from activities that may cause pollution.
facts.expected_handling: Require an emissions-control basis before accepting control status.

facts.source_fact: Waste treatment processes must be contained so process emissions are collected, extracted and directed to appropriate abatement before release.
facts.expected_handling: Record containment and abatement path for process emissions.

facts.source_fact: The site emissions inventory must identify main chemical constituents of point-source emissions to air and include VOC speciation where identified.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve inventory constituent and VOC-speciation evidence.

facts.source_fact: The fate and impact of substances emitted to air must be assessed using the Environment Agency air-emissions risk-assessment methodology.
facts.expected_handling: Keep risk-assessment provenance with emissions controls.

facts.source_fact: Appropriate abatement for point-source releases may include adsorption, fabric filtration, wet scrubbing, HEPA filtration, condensation, cyclones, electrostatic precipitation or thermal oxidation.
facts.expected_handling: Record the selected technique without assuming one technique applies universally.

facts.source_fact: Waste-gas treatment systems must be appropriately designed, operated within design ranges and maintained for availability and effectiveness.
facts.expected_handling: Carry design-range and maintenance evidence with abatement status.

facts.source_fact: Vent and stack locations and heights must be assessed and designed for adequate dispersion capability.
facts.expected_handling: Keep dispersion-design evidence separate from measured emissions.

facts.source_fact: Where monitoring is required, suitable monitoring points must meet Environment Agency MCERTS standards.
Storage and treatment plant must prevent or minimise fugitive emissions and operators must maintain a leak-detection-and-repair programme for relevant plant and infrastructure.
facts.expected_handling: Track fugitive-emissions prevention and LDAR separately from point-source controls.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited official fact and its scope.

guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Applying controls outside the permitted activity.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry control, risk-assessment and monitoring provenance.
Distinguish point-source and fugitive emission pathways.
Keep installed, operating and maintained states distinct.
Preserve MCERTS applicability where monitoring is required.
Require inventory and supporting records before PASS.
Do not convert facility controls into parcel-level measured emissions.
Flag source conflict or missing permit evidence for review.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
